title: Forever Faithful
meta_description: Find the perfect WaterColor, FL vacation rental at ‘‘Forever Faithful” a Luxury 5 Bedroom, 5.5 Bathroom vacation rental. Ideal for 12 guests, this home offers a private pool, access to WaterColor’s resort amenities, bikes & 6-seater golf cart.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: • 5 Bedrooms • 5.5 Bathrooms • New Private Pool (Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $40 per day) • Four Screened Porches • 3 Stories & 2,423 Square Feet • 6 Seater Golf Cart & 6 Adult Bikes Included • Parking for 3 Vehicles • Access to WaterColor’s Resort Amenities including the Beach Club • Private Beach Access * Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 12 wristbands.* SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS FIRST FLOOR: • Bedroom 1: King Guest Suite (sleeps 2) King Bed and Ensuite Bathroom with Single Vanity & Tile/Glass Shower SECOND FLOOR: • Bedroom 2: Primary Guest Suite (sleeps 2): King Bed and Ensuite Bathroom with Double Vanities, Soaking Tub & Walk-in Tile/Glass Shower • Bedroom 3: King Guest Suite (sleeps 2): King Bed and Ensuite Bathroom with Single Vanity & Shower/Tub Combination • Bedroom 4: King Guest Suite (sleeps 2) King Bed and Ensuite Bathroom with Single Vanity & Tile/Glass Shower • Bedroom 5: Bunk Room (sleeps 2) with Twin over Twin Bunks THIRD FLOOR • Loft: Double Bed and Two Twin over Twin Bunk Beds with Ensuite Bathroom (Sleeps 6), Single Vanity & Tile/Glass Shower DESCRIPTION: Nestled in the heart of WaterColor, Forever Faithful invites you to embrace the perfect blend of coastal chic design and timeless Southern charm. This elegant 5-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom retreat is a testament to the allure of vacationing along the stunning Emerald Coast. True to its name, Forever Faithful promises an unforgettable escape, where you’ll find yourself forever faithful to the art of relaxation and rejuvenation. Step inside this exquisite three-story haven, where hardwood floors and coffered ceilings set the stage for luxury living. The open-concept great room boasts plush seating and a 70” TV, seamlessly flowing into a gourmet kitchen equipped with top-tier appliances, including a 6-burner gas range. Whether you’re preparing a coastal feast or enjoying morning coffee, the spacious dining areas offer ample options—a formal table for 8, a breakfast bar with seating for 6, and a 10-person table on one of four enchanting screened-in porches. Outdoors, soak up the Florida sunshine beside your private pool, relax in Adirondack chairs, or enjoy alfresco dining surrounded by lush greenery. The first-floor guest suite with a king bed and private bath ensures comfort and convenience. The second floor features the primary suite, a serene retreat with a king bed, luxurious en suite bath, and access to a private porch. Two additional guest rooms, each with king beds and private baths, exude understated elegance, while the charming bunk room with twin-over-twin beds offers a whimsical escape for younger guests. A screened-in balcony with a bed swing and ping-pong table provides the perfect spot for leisurely afternoons. Climb the spiral staircase to the third-floor loft, a delightful haven for kids, complete with a double bed, two twin-over-twin bunks, a Smart TV, and a private bath. Forever Faithful offers unparalleled access to WaterColor’s premier amenities, blending the charm of a small beach town with luxurious resort offerings. Dive into multiple resort-style pools, stroll along nature trails, or explore nearby beaches via the provided 6-passenger golf cart or 6 complimentary adult bikes. For water enthusiasts, the exclusive WaterColor Beach Club provides a serene escape to the turquoise waters and sugar-white sands of the Emerald Coast, while Western Lake invites paddleboarding, kayaking, and fishing. Sports enthusiasts can enjoy tennis and pickleball courts, while families will love Camp WaterColor’s waterslides, lazy river, and vibrant poolside grill. Beautifully landscaped parks, and acclaimed restaurants add to the appeal, ensuring every moment is as relaxing or adventurous as you desire. Forever Faithful is more than a home—it’s a promise of cherished memories, coastal elegance, and the irresistible charm of WaterColor living. Reserve your stay today and discover why you’ll always be faithful to vacationing here. LAYOUT: FIRST FLOOR: • Main Living Space • Dining Room Seats 8 • Kitchen with Large Island Seats 6 • King Guest Suite with Ensuite Bath • Half Bathroom • Laundry Room with Sink SECOND FLOOR: • Bunk Room • Primary King Suite with Ensuite Bath • King Guest Suite with Ensuite Bath • King Guest Suite with Ensuite Bath THIRD FLOOR: • Loft with Bunks and Full Bed OUTDOOR AREA: • New! Heated Pool & Adirondack Chairs • Four Screened Porches • Outdoor screened dining area for 10 • Outdoor screened dining area for 6 by pool CONVENIENT LOCATION: • Publix Shopping Center (0.1 Miles) • WaterColor Beach Club (0.8 Miles) • Seaside (0.6 Miles) • Grayton Beach (3 Miles)
